spells.name: Animal Friend
spells.description: A small, natural animal regards you as a friend and will not attack you.

spells.name: Bearings
spells.description: You instantly know which way is north and roughly where you stand.

spells.name: Careful Step
spells.description: You tread lightly, leaving no tracks and making little sound.

spells.name: Dart
spells.description: A bolt of raw magic strikes a target.

spells.name: Dazzle
spells.description: A flash of light; the target must pass a test or be momentarily dazzled.

spells.name: Drain
spells.description: Drain the liquid from a vessel or sodden object.

spells.name: Eavesdrop
spells.description: Hear a distant conversation as though you stood beside it.

spells.name: Gust
spells.description: A sudden gust extinguishes candles and pushes lighter objects.

spells.name: Light
spells.description: A held object glows like a candle.

spells.name: Magic Flame
spells.description: Conjure a small, harmless flame in your palm or on an object.

spells.name: Marsh Lights
spells.description: A drifting will-o'-the-wisp you steer to lead or mislead the credulous.

spells.name: Open Lock
spells.description: A simple lock springs open at your touch.

spells.name: Produce Small Animal
spells.description: Conjure a small, harmless animal from thin air.

spells.name: Protection From Rain
spells.description: Rain and drizzle part around you; you stay dry.

spells.name: Purify Water
spells.description: Cleanse a quantity of water of filth and taint.

spells.name: Rot
spells.description: Hasten the rot and decay of food, cloth, or untreated wood.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.description: A target who fails to resist is overcome by drowsiness and sleeps.

spells.name: Sly Hands
spells.description: Pilfer or plant a small object at a distance with unseen hands.

spells.name: Sounds
spells.description: An illusory noise of your choosing emanates from a point you can see.

spells.name: Spring
spells.description: A small spring of clean water wells up from the ground.

spells.name: Twitch
spells.description: Cause a muscle to spasm, fumbling a grip or a step.

spells.name: Warning
spells.description: Ward a threshold; you sense when something crosses it.

spells.name: Aethyric Armour
spells.description: Sheathe yourself in aethyric force, gaining magical Armour Points.

spells.name: Aethyric Arms
spells.description: Conjure a weapon of pure magic to fight with.

spells.name: Arrow Shield
spells.description: A shimmering ward deflects incoming missiles.

spells.name: Belligerence of the Bloodmarsh
spells.description: Stoke a reckless aggression in those within the area.

spells.name: Blast
spells.description: A blast of aethyric force erupts at a point.

spells.name: Bolt
spells.description: A bolt of magical force streaks to a single target.

spells.name: Breath
spells.description: Exhale a cone of elemental energy.

spells.name: Bridge
spells.description: Conjure a bridge of force spanning a gap.

spells.name: Chain Attack
spells.description: An attack leaps from the first target to others nearby.

spells.name: Collapse Construct
spells.description: Wrench a building or construct so that it collapses.

spells.name: Corrosive Blood
spells.description: Your blood becomes acid, harming those who wound you.

spells.name: Dark Vision
spells.description: The target sees clearly in total darkness.

spells.name: Decipher Curse
spells.description: Lay bare the nature and trigger of a curse or hex.

spells.name: Disrupt Magic
spells.description: Unravel an active spell or counter one as it is cast.

spells.name: Distracting
spells.description: A flickering glamour distracts a target, penalising their tests.

spells.name: Dome
spells.description: A protective dome of force shelters those beneath it.

spells.name: Drop
spells.description: A target must pass a test or drop whatever they hold.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.description: Bands of force seize a target, who gains the Entangled condition.

spells.name: Fearsome
spells.description: You take on a dread aspect, causing Fear in those near you.

spells.name: Flight
spells.description: The target rises and flies through the air.

spells.name: Fly Infested Rotweed
spells.description: Rotting weed and biting flies choke an area, harrying those within.

spells.name: Lifebloom Silt
spells.description: Fertile silt blooms with life, soothing and healing those upon it.

spells.name: Magic Shield
spells.description: A disc of force guards you like a shield.

spells.name: Move Object
spells.description: Lift and move an object at a distance by will alone.

spells.name: Mundane Aura
spells.description: Mask your magic, appearing utterly mundane to sight and sense.

spells.name: Push
spells.description: A shove of force hurls a target back, perhaps off their feet.

spells.name: Silence
spells.description: An unnatural quiet smothers all sound within the area.

spells.name: Succour Magical Servant
spells.description: Mend and empower a familiar or conjured servant.

spells.name: Teleport
spells.description: Vanish and reappear at a point you can see up to WPB×10 yards away.

spells.name: Terrifying
spells.description: You become a thing of nightmare, causing Terror in onlookers.

spells.name: Ward
spells.description: Inscribe a ward that turns aside a chosen kind of harm.

spells.name: Aqshy's Aegis
spells.description: A shroud of heat-haze wards you, searing those who strike you in melee.

spells.name: Body of Fire
spells.description: Your body becomes living flame; you burn all you touch and resist fire.

spells.name: Boiling Blood
spells.description: The target's blood seethes and boils within them.

spells.name: Burning Head
spells.description: A screaming skull of fire streaks through the foe, leaving terror in its wake.

spells.name: Captivating Flame
spells.description: A mesmerising flame holds the gaze of those who fail to look away.

spells.name: Cauterise
spells.description: A bleeding wound is seared shut. Removes the Bleeding condition; deals 1 damage.

spells.name: Choleric
spells.description: Inflame a target's temper into reckless, choleric rage.

spells.name: Crown of Flame
spells.description: Your head is wreathed in flame. +1 SL on Intimidate; melee attackers are burned.

spells.name: Flamestorm
spells.description: A roaring storm of fire engulfs the target point.

spells.name: Flaming Hearts
spells.description: Allies' courage blazes; they become immune to Fear and gain +1 SL on attacks.

spells.name: Flaming Sword of Rhuin
spells.description: A weapon is wreathed in fire, dealing extra damage and counting as magical.

spells.name: Firewall
spells.description: A wall of flame springs up. Anyone crossing it is burned.

spells.name: Forge of Tarnus
spells.description: Superheat metal — a weapon, lock, or suit of armour glows and softens.

spells.name: Great Fires of U'Zhul
spells.description: A cataclysmic firestorm consumes everything within a vast area.

spells.name: Ignite
spells.description: Set a flammable object or creature alight, inflicting Ablaze.

spells.name: Inextinguishable Flame
spells.description: A flame that cannot be doused by water or smothering burns on.

spells.name: Kindleflame
spells.description: Kindle a small flame to light a torch, lamp, or tinder.

spells.name: Kindred of the Hearth
spells.description: Those gathered at your hearth are warmed, soothed, and bound in fellowship.

spells.name: Magma Storm
spells.description: Molten rock rains down upon the target area.

spells.name: Ceaseless Flame
spells.description: A flame set burning needs no fuel and will not go out for the duration.

spells.name: Comfort
spells.description: The target is wrapped in gentle warmth, comfortable in any cold.

spells.name: Flashcook
spells.description: Instantly cook a quantity of raw food to perfection.

spells.name: Azure Blades
spells.description: Blades of blue lightning slash at the target.

spells.name: Cerulean Shield
spells.description: A shield of azure light turns aside blows and bolts alike.

spells.name: Comet of Casandora
spells.description: A blazing comet falls upon the foe, smiting all beneath it.

spells.name: Curse of Fate
spells.description: Ill fortune dogs the target; they suffer a penalty to their tests.

spells.name: Divination
spells.description: Read the skeins of fate for an omen of things to come.

spells.name: Enemy Foreseen
spells.description: Foresight warns you of attacks; you cannot be Surprised.

spells.name: Fantastic Foresight
spells.description: Allies move with prescient timing, gaining +1 SL to their actions.

spells.name: Fate's Fickle Fingers
spells.description: Twist a target's luck so their next fortune turns to misfortune.

spells.name: Fate Illuminated
spells.description: A target's destiny is laid bare, revealing a truth about their path.

spells.name: Lens on the Sky
spells.description: Scry a distant place as though gazing down from the heavens.

spells.name: Let the Four Winds Blow!
spells.description: Conjure roaring winds from every quarter, scattering all before them.

spells.name: Mistral From the Stratosphere
spells.description: A blast of stratospheric cold sears the target area.

spells.name: Mystic Mirror
spells.description: A reflective surface becomes a window for scrying.

spells.name: Polish and Glean
spells.description: Clean and burnish an object, gleaning a hint of its recent history.

spells.name: Project Spirit
spells.description: Your spirit leaves your body to travel unseen upon the winds.

spells.name: Sapphire Arch
spells.description: An arch of blue light bears those who pass through it a great distance.

spells.name: Starcrossed
spells.description: Bind two fates together so that what befalls one befalls the other.

spells.name: Starshine
spells.description: Soft starlight bathes the area, banishing shadow and easing fear.

spells.name: Storm of Shentek
spells.description: A furious tempest of wind and lightning ravages the area.

spells.name: T'Essla's Arc
spells.description: A bolt of lightning arcs from target to target across the field.

spells.name: The First Portent of Amul
spells.description: A minor portent lets one ally reroll a single failed test.

spells.name: The Second Portent of Amul
spells.description: A greater portent grants allies foresight, adding to their tests.

spells.name: The Third Portent of Amul
spells.description: A dire portent dooms a foe, turning their own fate against them.

spells.name: Thorsen's Thunderstorm
spells.description: A rolling thunderstorm batters the area with rain and lightning.

spells.name: Birdspeech
spells.description: Understand and speak with the birds of the air.

spells.name: Gale
spells.description: A sudden gale buffets the area, scattering missiles and the unwary.

spells.name: Weathervane
spells.description: Read and gently nudge the local weather over the hours to come.

spells.name: Blessings of Bel Shanaar
spells.description: An Elven blessing shields allies from harm and ill fortune.

spells.name: Niezlib's Optimal Firing Solution
spells.description: Celestial calculation guides allies' shots, adding SL to ranged attacks.

spells.name: Sea of Glass
spells.description: The ground turns to slick, mirror-smooth glass, treacherous underfoot.

spells.name: The Amber Spear
spells.description: A spear of amber-brown magic impales a single foe.

spells.name: Deathsight
spells.description: You perceive the ebbing of life around you and sense the recently dead.

spells.name: Steal Life
spells.description: Leech the living essence from a victim to mend your own wounds.

spells.name: The Caress of Laniph
spells.description: A withering touch of pure death saps the strength from the target's limbs.

spells.name: The Fate of Bjuna
spells.description: The target is racked with unspeakable agony and may perish where they stand.

spells.name: Soul Vortex
spells.description: A whirlwind of screaming spirits tears at every soul caught within.

spells.name: Earthblood
spells.description: Verdant magic knits flesh and bark alike, healing the target over time.

spells.name: The Dwellers Below
spells.description: Grasping roots drag the rooted-in-place down into the hungry earth.

spells.name: Glittering Robe
spells.description: A robe of pure Hysh sheathes the target in radiant magical Armour Points.

spells.name: Pha's Protection
spells.description: Warding light shields allies from harm and the touch of evil.

spells.name: Net of Amyntok
spells.description: A net of golden light binds the target; struggling only burns them.

spells.name: Banishment
spells.description: Searing light banishes daemons and undead back to whence they came.

spells.name: Enchant Weapon
spells.description: A weapon is sheathed in Chamon, counting as magical and biting deeper.

spells.name: Crucible of Chamon
spells.description: Molten metal erupts from the ground in a searing, spattering gout.

spells.name: Bewilder
spells.description: The target is briefly befuddled, losing their next action to confusion.

spells.name: Melkoth's Mystifying Miasma
spells.description: A confounding fog clings to the target, penalising all of their tests.

spells.name: Doppelganger
spells.description: The target's features shift to mimic another person they have seen.

rows.effect: Snap! A loud bang; one round of ringing ears (Surprised 1).
Smoke billows from the caster; Stunned 1.
A sigil burns onto the caster's skin; 1 damage, ignoring armour.
Aethyric backlash: caster suffers 1 stack of Fatigued.
Reality wobbles; caster gains 1 Corruption point.
A small fire breaks out in 3-yard radius; everyone in it: Burning condition stack.
Aethyric vortex; caster takes SB+2 damage and gains Stunned 1.
Wraith eyes! The caster sees the dead until end of scene.
Daemon stirs — caster gains 1 Corruption + a Disorder roll (off-screen).
